message.content: Hippoplaisir is a psychologists & counseling services provider based in Belgium, that specializes in Horse Riding Lessons and Equine-Assisted Therapy. Our mission is to provide exceptional therapy services and promote mental health awareness through our equine programs. Our experienced team of psychologists and equine specialists work together to create a safe and supportive environment for individuals seeking therapy. We believe in the power of horses to help individuals overcome emotional and psychological challenges and strive to provide the highest quality of care to all of our clients.

Hippoplaisir is a psychologist & counseling services provider based in Belgium. The company specializes in horse riding lessons and equine-assisted therapy. They offer a range of services to help individuals improve their mental and emotional well-being through interaction with horses. These services include individual therapy, group therapy, and workshops for various populations, such as children, adults, and families. Hippoplaisir also provides training for mental health professionals interested in incorporating equine-assisted therapy into their practice. The company's mission is to provide a safe, supportive, and healing environment where individuals can work towards their goals and improve their overall quality of life.
